name: motiondev
description: See what your coding agent is building, live: pictograms that form as it works, in the Claude Code chat, in any terminal, and (soon) under the Mac notch.

pane.title: Open the window at session start
pane.description: Open the motiondev window (a docked pane) when a session starts. Off: /motiondev opens it on demand.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Draw the current scene and what was built above the prompt. Off: the hooks still write ~/.motiondev/events.jsonl for the terminal watcher.

details.title: Start with the pictogram open
details.description: Show the full pictogram in the band from the start. Off: one compact line, with a button to open it.
